description: This file contains functions related to importing and exporting CSV data within the TestLink open-source testing management system. It defines functions for exporting data to CSV format and importing CSV data, handling details like headers, delimiters, field validation, and line processing.

methods.name: exportDataToCSV
methods.description: Exports an array of data to a CSV formatted string, optionally including headers and custom delimiters.

methods.name: importCSVData
methods.description: Imports CSV data from a specified file, applying field mappings and options such as delimiter and header processing, returning parsed data and errors.
